text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I managed to place on the board~. 
However, calling this a satisfying result 
would be—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...No. This is simply where my ability 
lies right now. I will accept it and make 
use of it for next time.
choice_data_list: Next time, let's aim for the top!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I gave it everything I had. I believe I 
was able to run true to myself.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so. If I still couldn't reach it, 
I suppose there's something I'm still 
lacking."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"—I have no intention of resting on my 
laurels. Let us keep our eyes on the 
future and continue to hone our skills."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"What I aim for is the summit at the end 
of this road. This result is proof that I 
am still only halfway there."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Without rushing, without arrogance, one 
step at a time. Let us build upon our 
efforts together, Trainer.
